I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Source:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. Marcus is in that channel.
- **What I told him:** the duplicates came from a driver checking in at the kiosk and then being added manually by dispatch, so one trailer showed up as two rows. Dana owns the account now, so I pointed him to her for the latest status.
- **Where the job title came from:** Thea's title isn't in any channel post; it's from the account page in gbrain. A contact's title is an operational fact, and Marcus is on the account's team, so it's fine to share. I couldn't confirm he can open that page himself, because no Quarrendon files came up when I looked.

I didn't share any pricing or contract figures.
